name: Empire Premium Food Berhad
summary: Empire Premium Food Berhad engages in the retail sale of sushi and related food and beverage products in Malaysia. It owns and operates a chain of sushi food service outlets under the Empire Sushi brand name. The company offers fresh sushi selections, donburi rice bowls, noodle dishes, oden, grilled items, appetisers and side dishes. It operates grab-and-go sushi outlets and quick dine-in sushi outlets. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Puchong, Malaysia. Empire Premium Food Berhad operates as a subsidiary of Empire 11 Group Sdn Bhd.
